facts.text: Soft feet on the sand path, and nobody drops a plate. Marcus, stay beside me.
facts.why: Not a Lee line. His only lines on the quote page are 'Of course I do.', 'I love you. I've always loved you.' and 'I'll find them.' The rest of the film is sign language. Printed in quote marks and signed Lee Abbott.
facts.fix: I love you. I've always loved you.

fix_note.text: I love you. I've always loved you.

facts.text: Evelyn's garden, picked barefoot off the sand path.
facts.why: Barefoot on the sand paths is right, but no source mentions a garden. They do mention hundreds of canned vegetable jars in the basement and plenty of corn fields. The dish name 'Garden tomatoes, sea salt and basil' carries the same idea.
facts.fix: From the cellar shelves, a jar of Evelyn's canning, opened without a sound.

vibe.verdict: Quiet, witty menu that turns the leaf dinner, sand paths and silo into dishes, held back by one invented Lee quote and a garden the film never shows.
